content:
Apple One offers bundled packages covering several popular Apple services, and in iOS 27, the top-tier Premier plan will gain a number of new advantages.

Apple One Premier will introduce two upgrades in iOS 27, both related to Apple Intelligence.

If you're an Apple One user looking for an extra reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 may be just that reason.

The new iPhone system software brings two upgrades to the top-tier Apple One plan.

  • Apple Home AI features
  • Increased image generation usage limits and more

Apple's Home app will add various AI features in iOS 27, some of which are exclusive to iCloud+ subscribers on the 2TB plan—meaning you must subscribe to Apple One Premier or the highest-tier standalone iCloud+ plan to use them.

It remains unclear whether all AI features or only some are tied to subscription plans. The iOS 27 beta notes simply state: 'Apple Intelligence for Home requires an iCloud+ subscription of 2TB or higher.'

However, at least some HomeKit Secure Video upgrades are likely to require the top-tier plan, including features such as video description generation, clip search, and automatic highlighting of important moments.

If you need a camera compatible with HomeKit Secure Video, consider:

  • Aqara G100 2K Smart Doorbell: $35 unbeatable value entry-level choice
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: supports 4K resolution, priced higher at $59

Additionally, some new AI features in iOS 27 (such as image generation) have daily usage limits. According to Apple, Apple One Premier subscribers will enjoy higher usage limits:

The iCloud+ plan included in Apple One's Individual plan does not qualify. So if you want higher AI usage allowances, this is yet another reason to choose Apple One Premier.

Apple One starts at $19.95 per month and covers multiple services including Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and more.
